title: In Norway, Everyone Can Know How Much You Earn
summary: Tom Scott explains how in Norway and other Nordic countries tax returns, and so individual incomes, are public. He looks at the effects of wage transparency and whether it is a good idea, with sources listed in the description.
why: HN points to it in discussions of salary transparency as a short, well-sourced overview of how public tax records work in Nordic countries.

quote.text: Interesting video about somewhat public tax returns, and hence salary, in Norway and other Nordic countries.
